summary: Iteration 23 - Bug Fixes Testing Complete. All 9 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Accounting page shows Estado column with Pagado/Pendiente badges, Public registration shows payment required block when plan selected, Member PWA home shows pending payment block for pending members. Fixed JWT token bug in public registration (type->role).
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed JWT token bug in member_routes.py line 104: changed 'type' to 'role' in create_jwt_token() call for public registration. This was causing class bookings to fail with 'Only members can book classes' error because the booking endpoint checks for role='member' not type='member'.
seed_data_creation: Multiple test pending members created during testing (test_pending_*, test_qr_pending_*, test_booking_pending_*, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 23 tested all bug fixes: 1) Public registration with plan creates pending member with requires_payment=true, 2) Public registration without plan creates active member, 3) QR generation blocked for pending members (403), 4) QR generation works for active members with active membership, 5) Class bookings blocked for pending members (403), 6) Accounting transactions endpoint returns payment_status field, 7) Accounting report only includes paid transactions in revenue totals, 8) Admin accounting page shows Estado column with Pagado/Pendiente badges, 9) Public registration shows payment required block, 10) Member PWA home shows pending payment block. Fixed JWT token bug in member_routes.py (type->role).

bug_fix_applied.issue: JWT token created with 'type': 'member' instead of 'role': 'member'
bug_fix_applied.fix: Changed create_jwt_token({'sub': member_dict['id'], 'type': 'member', ...}) to create_jwt_token({'sub': member_dict['id'], 'role': 'member', ...})
